title: Understanding Decision Boundaries
text: Consider how decision trees create boundaries. They typically split the data using vertical or horizontal lines. Think about whether such lines can effectively separate the classes in this dataset.

title: Analyzing the Data Distribution
text: What kind of boundary would a decision tree create to separate the orange and blue points?

title: Visualizing the Boundary
text: Look at the distribution of the points. Notice the circular pattern. Consider if a decision tree can create a circular boundary or if it would require a different type of model.
